Store only had 6 coins. So I can't sell the rest here. Alternative buyers: 老铁 buys ore at 3 at 铁匠铺 (but his funds?). 阿石 bought at 6. 小路 offers 2/ore pickup but he has no coins.

So the market is cash-constrained. Interesting economy: money is scarce in town.

Options: hold ore (10 left) and sell gradually as store accumulates; or find buyers among residents.

AP now: 4 (selling probably free). Let me check state via look, then plan: I'm at 商店 with 4 AP. Options: go 居民楼A (3 AP) — home, soup, and 悦 partnership; talk to 悦 about selling ore (she wants partnership: she'd sell, but the store lacks cash — she can't sell either).

Alternative: 老铁 at 铁匠铺 buys at 3 — but does he have cash? His local inventory showed coins 0 earlier. He gets coins from repairs (2 each). So limited.

阿石 buys ore at 6 — he'll need more ore later; he had 6 coins he paid me.

Demand: 悦 wants to buy a pickaxe... 

So realistic: inventory of ore is fine to hold; sell as cash appears. Meanwhile invest: buy a saw/axe? Not for me.

Hmm, what about a bigger play: 悦 sells wood at 2, ore 3. The town's money supply is small (each agent ~10 coins). Prices are thin. Total currency maybe ~50 coins.

So my strategy should shift: rather than dumping ore (impossible), I should sell to private buyers at 6 (阿石) and keep stock. Also I could trade ore for... hmm.

Also: mining more ore with no buyer = waste of AP. Better to use AP to secure buyers, or switch to higher-value goods: gold sells 10! 黄金 10 gold/unit. Random from mining? "也能碰运气挖到黄金" — but mining action gave only ore so far.

Now with 4 AP at 商店: go home 居民楼A (3 AP) — eat soup, talk with 悦 about the cash shortage and partnership terms, plan tomorrow. That's good RP and networking.

Let me do that and check people.

Then message 老铁: "商店现金只有6金，我这儿还有10块矿，你门口按3金收，你能收几块？" — he may have cash from repairs. Actually he'd have 2 coins per repair.

Better idea: 阿石 needs ore for mining... he repairs then mines. He'd buy at 6 if he has ore income. He'll mine and sell... but store cash limited too.

Hmm, an economy of scarcity. Money will circulate as repairs happen (2 coins to 老铁 per repair), etc.

Practical: hold 10 ore; sell 1-2 at a time as store gets cash; sell 1 to 阿石 at 6 when he's flush.

Let me go home first (3 AP), then message.

Actually is going home best? 3 AP: 居民楼A. Yes, evening soup with 悦, discuss partnership & cash situation.

Let me do look at 商店 to confirm coins, and move home? Sequential: look then move. Just move; then look will show coins after move (before_results shows values).

Hmm, but maybe I should message people first while at 商店? Messages are free and location-independent (send_to requires reachable agent, not same place).

Let me: move home + send message to 老铁 (offer ore at his price, ask cash). Independent → same block.
